transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm having a really hard time because I keep getting these awful, sudden memories of a terrible event that happened about two years and four months ago. They just flash back into my mind during the day, and at night I'm constantly waking up from horrible nightmares. I really just need help making them stop.
I understand these symptoms have been persisting since the event occurred over two years ago; have you experienced these intrusive memories and nightmares consistently throughout this entire period?

Yes, I have been experiencing them constantly without any real break ever since it happened two years and four months ago. There hasn't been a single week where I haven't had to deal with the memories during the day and the nightmares at night.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports symptoms persisting for over two years and four months. Acute Stress Disorder is defined by symptoms lasting between three days and one month following a traumatic event. Since the symptoms have persisted well beyond the one-month threshold, Acute Stress Disorder is ruled out, leaving Posttraumatic Stress Disorder as the diagnosis.
